text:
Ava (Marketing): Quick update on SlateCase case production. Need final quote wording, embargo window, webinar mention, and lead routing rules. Can we lock today?
Chen (Content): I have a draft hero stat but holding until we get legal OK on the exact phrasing. Also sketching the social teaser variants.
Liam (PMM): For messaging, let's prioritize "latency at scale" + "cost per request". Two-line quote suggested: 'Redwood cut our inference latency by 60% while halving per-request cost.' Will craft shorter versions.
Marco (CSM): Olga confirmed internal metric sheet is live. They asked that any absolute pairwise comparisons include the month of the test.
Rina (Legal): Please send the test snapshot and the dataset summary to legal@redwood. If we use the logo, add a trademark clause to the opt-in doc. Embargo requested?
Olga (SlateCase): One-week embargo after internal approval. Also ask Product to approve any architecture diagrams that show their pipeline.
Ava (Marketing): Noted. @Liam can you add the parenthetical: '(based on internal tests, Mar 2026)' to the hero stat to be safe?
Liam (PMM): Yep. I'll add that and provide a short fallback quote in case they want softer wording.
Nate (Sales): Lead flow plan: webinar registrants -> tag 'slatecase-webinar' -> attended >= 30% -> 'webinar-engaged' -> send to AE queue 'Dedicated-Q2'. I'll create the webhook mapping and a Zap for CSV fallback.
Chen (Content): Interview logistics: 30m remote; aim for a soundbite about developer experience. My suggested questions:```
- What was the deployment timeline?
- How did engineering measure latency/cost?
- Any surprising operational wins?
- What advice for other infra teams?
```
Marco (CSM): I'm booking two slots Tue/Wed 10-10:30. Olga?
Olga (SlateCase): Tue works. Will have their infra lead and PM on the call.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: marketing/case-assets v1.2 -> staging (no downtime).
Chen (Content): After interview I'll produce: short quote, 3 social teasers, hero graphic, and a benchmark appendix. Will need Eng logs for appendix.
Liam (PMM): I'll coordinate with Eng to pull the perf logs and a brief method note (batch sizes, seq len distribution).
Rina (Legal): Once the quote text and appendix are uploaded, I'll aim to review within 24 hours. If they insist on removing numbers, we'll use relative language.
Ava (Marketing): Timeline proposal: interview Tue, legal signoff Wed, assets in staging by Fri, embargo lifts one week after internal review -> publish + webinar mention week after. Any blockers?
Nate (Sales): Make sure the webinar CTA captures company size and persona so I can prioritize leads.
Olga (SlateCase): We'll anonymize customer IDs in logs and consent to publish the quote and one dashboard screenshot.
Chen (Content): I'll add a watermark to screenshots and keep raw logs in the appendix behind the legal review link.
Marco (CSM): I'll post the private metrics sheet to the shared drive and ping everyone once live.
Ava (Marketing): Great. Closing loop: Liam adds parenthetical to hero stat, Eng shares perf logs to legal, interview Tue, legal by Wed, assets ready Fri, embargo noted. If anything changes call it out here. Thanks!
